name: Please Be Quiet Beijing 2024
information:
Please check the competition website for registration, schedule, etc.

This competition limits the number of registrations by event:
3x3x3 Blindfolded: 50 
4x4x4 Blindfolded: 25
5x5x5 Blindfolded: 25
3x3x3 Multi-Blind: 25
3x3x3 Fewest Moves: 50
Each event will be based on first-come-first-served basis according to the order of registration, and 175 competitors will be the theoretical maximum of the number of registrations.
